title: Homesick
description: Lola Jonabel misses Aklan, so you fly home with her and Papa Jobert. At Kalibo Airport you meet Lola Susan and your cousin Rose, who agrees to teach you Akeanon.

title: Kalibo Town
description: Home at last. Rose walks you through Kalibo: Pastrana Park, the public market, and the cathedral. Once the tour is done, ask her whenever you want to go out again.
learn: Places, food, numbers 6 to 10, colors, and size words

title: Threads of Piña
description: Visit a piña weaving community. Manang Loleng shows you how pineapple fiber becomes cloth, and you try the loom yourself.
learn: Action words and words for speed and size

title: Roots of Bakhawan
description: Explore the Bakhawan Eco-Park with its caretaker, Manong Ambo. Learn how mangrove roots protect the town from storms, then try fishing.

title: Hala Bira!
description: The Ati-Atihan festival fills Kalibo with drums. Kapitan Julian welcomes your family, and you join the street cheer.
learn: Festival words and words for people

title: Homeward
description: One last trip, from the Caticlan jetty to Boracay. Tita Beth explains how tourism supports local people before it is time to say goodbye.
